device: Android SDK built for x86_64 / Android 5.0.2 (API 21)
method: ADB coordinate replay with equal pauses (2 s per action, 0.3 s per character, 10 s final rest); preparation by view hierarchy outside the windows; fresh app data and reseeded backend each pass; process kept between stories; no forced GC; device uptime clock; CPU App from /proc every 0.2 s; memory from /proc/PID/smaps read with run-as outside the app every ~0.5 s, private memory grouped like Android App Summary (Studio Total formula, not PSS); dumpsys meminfo not used because on API 21 it forces GCs in the app.
